profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer | M.S. Computer Vision (UCF) | Lockheed Martin
profile.summary:
Embedded Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience building real-time, mission-critical systems across defense, aerospace, and applied AI.

My background spans embedded and systems software, computer vision, and real-time AI pipelines, with hands-on experience supporting U.S. defense programs and operational research environments.
I’ve worked on autonomous systems, drone simulation, real-time inference platforms, and computer vision solutions using C/C++, Python, CUDA, ROS, Unreal Engine, and modern ML frameworks. My work has included optimizing inference performance, building execution tooling, and integrating AI models into production systems.

Currently, I’m an Embedded Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin, while completing a Master’s in Computer Vision at University of Central Florida.

I’m especially interested in real-time systems, autonomy, embedded AI, and advanced sensing applications.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ - Designed WingmanAI model execution UI, intended for model supply and exchange.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ - Optimized runtime per inference frame for video object detection algorithms.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Image Processing (Sponsored Project)
positions.description:
Drone Swarm Search & Rescue Mission:
• Designed autonomous drone navigation simulation using Microsoft AirSim and Unreal Engine.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎  ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎  - Assigned waypoints using infrared cameras, edge detection and pixel clustering; Open CV.
• Trained a deep learning model using the YOLOv5 object detection algorithm and Pytorch.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎  ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎  - Optimized CNN layers to detect a person by adjusting hyperparameters.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎  ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎  - Automated 50,000 image dataset collection and labeling.
• Calculated GPS location of target in an image, using geospatial localization and camera calibration.
• Allocated parallel processes on GPU for boid navigation using Cuda and ROS nodes.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern II - RF Microchip Simulation Test Automation
positions.description:
• Developed a Python-based automation and test framework to evaluate 100+ commercial RF mobile microchips (Apple and Samsung).
• Validated the accuracy of Mercury Suite conversion software from circuit-level RF microchip schematics (ANSYS/ADS) to HFSS electromagnetic simulations.
          - Detected port misalignment issues in RF geometries using ADS, AWR, and HFSS simulation tools.
          - Verified material, conductivity, temperature, and alignment parameters using XML data.
• Resolved backward compatibility issues involving PDKs within the Mercury Suite ADS plug-in.
• Integrated the testing framework into existing schematic-to-EM conversion automation workflows for BAW/SAW microchips.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern - Network Testing
positions.description:
• Performed frontend unit testing in Java JUnit for JWARN threat report web application for U.S. Army.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎  ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎  - Revealed unresponsive elements and asynchronous api issues.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎  ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎  - Eased transition from old Apache Tomcat stack server to new MERN stack framework.

Cornell Box ray tracing simulation.
Demonstrates color of walls reflecting off of primitive shapes in the center of the room.
Render time and quality varies based on pixel sampling.
